sources.summary: US studio Lehrer Architects has completed Loma Verde, a supportive housing development for once-homeless residents that features a slender footprint and stucco walls adorned with splashes of colour. Located in the city's Filipinotown neighbourhood, the Loma Verde project was built on a tight lot that formerly held a single-family home.
